question: Is the 5.0 default lane non-inferior to a bare agent, at no more than 1.5 times the tokens per solved task?
primary: paired per-task difference in success rate, somi5 minus bare; success means the hidden acceptance tests pass; each rate is over k draws; standard error clustered by task

rule.escalated_lane_claim: needs a positive lower bound on the hard subset

noise_floor: A/A, bare versus bare, same tasks and k; its interval must contain zero; re-run whenever the model pin changes

tiers.confirmatory: top-tier bare on the 6 hardest tasks, 18 draws
